lines.en: label beachsixmakoto1:
scene makotoiobath1
Not far at all from where we just were, different events were unfolding! Joyous events! The kind that make you wish you could be a part of them when there’s somewhere else you need to be!
lines.zh: 就在离我们刚才所在之处不远的地方，另一番景象正在展开！欢快的景象！那种明明另有要事在身、却让你恨不得自己也参与其中的景象！

lines.en: But that didn’t mean everyone present was happy about it.
lines.zh: 但这并不代表在场的每个人都乐在其中。

lines.en: : Fucking...slow down, Miku! Why are you running?! You’re going to hurt yourself!
lines.zh: : 他妈的……慢点，Miku！你跑什么？！你会受伤的！

lines.en: scene makotoiobath2
: Impossible! Miku Maruyama is immune to pain! And she is running because she can! Because she {i}must!{/i} And because that friggin’ hot spring is callin’ my name!
lines.zh: : 不可能！Miku Maruyama 对疼痛免疫！我跑是因为我能跑！因为我{i}必须{/i}跑！还因为那个该死的温泉在喊我的名字！

lines.en: scene makotoiobath3
: Can you at least put a towel on so you’re not running around completely naked then?
lines.zh: : 你至少能披条毛巾吧，别就这么光着到处跑？

lines.en: : Why? We’re just gonna be takin’ em off again in ten seconds, ain’t we? Makes way more sense to just let it all hang out, I think! Or...let nothin’ hang out in the case of me and Io.
lines.zh: : 为什么？反正十秒后又得脱掉，不是吗？我觉得干脆全晾着才更合理！或者……换我和 Io 的话，是什么都晾不出来。

lines.en: : I believe it’s less a matter of practicality and more one of sheer modesty, Miku. It’s sort of just an unwritten rule to stop running around without clothes on once you make it into high school.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这与其说是实用问题，不如说是纯粹的羞耻心问题，Miku。上了高中就别再光着身子乱跑，这算是某种不成文的规矩。

lines.en: : I think it’s kind of frowned upon before that too, but I’m not about to argue if what Makoto’s saying convinces you to be less, uhh...out there.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在那之前也不太受欢迎，不过要是 Makoto 的话能让你稍微收敛一点——呃……别那么放飞自我，我也不打算反驳。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath4
: It doesn’t!
lines.zh: : 才不会！

lines.en: scene makotoiobath5
: MARUYAMA SECRET TECHNIQUE — CANNONBALL!
lines.zh: : 丸山秘技——炮弹入水！

lines.en: : At least give it a more interesting name!
lines.zh: : 至少取个更有趣的名字吧！

lines.en: : Miku! Didn’t you read the signs?! Don’t even {i}think{/i} about jumping into that water! You’ll regret it! Seriously!
lines.zh: : Miku！你没看牌子吗？！连{i}想{/i}都别想跳进那水里！你会后悔的！我说真的！

lines.en: : Too late, Makoto! I’m-
lines.zh: : 晚了，Makoto！我——

lines.en: scene makotoiobath6
: AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH! WHY’S IT SO FRIGGIN’ LOUD?!?!?!!?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！为什么这么他妈吵？！？！？！？！

lines.en: : See? I {i}told{/i} you you’d regret. There were signs all over the place saying to not jump into the hot spring at the risk of it exploding.
lines.zh: : 看到了吧？我{i}早说过{/i}你会后悔。到处都贴着牌子，说别跳进温泉，否则有爆炸的危险。

lines.en: : WHY’S THAT EVEN A THING?!?!?!?! THIS WOULD’A TOTALLY CAUSED ME AN EPISODE LIKE FIFTY UPDATES AGO!!!
lines.zh: : 这算什么破设定？！？！？！？！要搁五十个版本之前，这绝对会让我发病的！！！

lines.en: : Exploding water...great. Let’s hope my aunt never hears about this. Sounds hard to clean.
lines.zh: : 会爆炸的水……真好。但愿我姑姑永远别听说这事。听起来很难清理。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath7
: Oh, right. Your family runs the local bathhouse, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。你家是开本地澡堂的，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s just my aunt and me. Not my family. And also, don’t talk to me. I am here only because Uta is hanging out with Sensei’s niece right now and I thought it was just going to be Miku and me.
lines.zh: : 只有我姑姑和我。不是我家。还有，别跟我说话。我来这儿只是因为 Uta 现在正和老师的外甥女混在一起，而我以为只会是我和 Miku 两个人。

lines.en: : {size=-1}I don’t intend to try and bond with you if that’s what you’re worried about. I just figured we might find some common ground as I’ve also been dragged into running {i}my{/i} family’s business.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}如果你担心的是这个，我并不打算跟你套近乎。我只是觉得我们或许能找到些共同点，因为我也被拖去经营{i}我家{/i}的生意。{/size}

lines.en: : With all due respect, which is basically none, I have heard about what your family’s business is. And I would much prefer it if you didn’t try to relate it to {i}my{/i} family’s legitimate one.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言——其实基本毫无敬意——我听说过你家做的是什么生意。我更希望你别拿它来跟{i}我家{/i}正当的生意相提并论。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath8
: I understand the sentiment. But if you really think about it, isn’t your place of work even more adult-oriented than mine? At least people have to wear clothes inside of my store.
lines.zh: : 我理解你的心情。可你真要细想，你工作的地方不是比我那儿更成人向吗？至少在我的店里，人们还得穿着衣服。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath9
: Okay. So {i}both{/i} of our workplaces suck. Do you really want that to be the launching point for trying and failing at getting to know me, though?
lines.zh: : 好吧。所以{i}咱俩{/i}的工作场所都烂透了。不过你真打算拿这个当起点、去试着了解我然后失败吗？

lines.en: : Not...really. I just know that you’re not exactly fond of things like this.
lines.zh: : 不……不太想。我只是知道你不太喜欢这种场合。

lines.en: : So it’s less me getting to know you and more trying to make myself seem relatable and familiar so you’re not uncomfortable with me being here as well.
lines.zh: : 所以与其说是我想了解你，不如说是想让自己显得好懂、熟悉一些，好让你不因为我在这儿而不自在。

lines.en: : Then just...don’t talk to me or look at me. In fact, stay away entirely. Just...do the complete opposite of everything {i}Miku{/i} did and...maybe I won’t want you to die.
lines.zh: : 那就……别跟我说话，也别看我。事实上，离我远点。你只要……把{i}Miku{/i}做过的每件事都反着来……也许我就不会想让你死了。

lines.en: : You don’t want Miku to die though, do you?
lines.zh: : 可你并不想让 Miku 死，对吧？

lines.en: : No. But I imagine her methods merely worked because I can convince myself she’s a boy if I squint my eyes hard enough. I’d have hated her if she was anyone else.
lines.zh: : 不想。不过我想她的法子之所以奏效，只是因为我把眼睛眯得够紧就能说服自己她是个男孩。换作别人，我早恨死她了。

lines.en: : Then why do you like Uta so much? She’s essentially as girly as they come.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么那么喜欢 Uta？她基本上算是女孩子气到极点了。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath10
: It’s complicated, okay?! Just mind your own fucking business!
lines.zh: : 很复杂，行了吧？！少管我的事！

lines.en: scene makotoiobath11
: {i}Miku! Close your eyes. I’m taking my towel off now. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Miku！闭上眼睛。我要把毛巾解下来了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Whaaaat?! We ain’t gonna compare boobs or somethin’?! Ain’t that how these hot springs scenes work?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啥——？！我们不是要比胸什么的吗？！温泉场景不都是这么演的吗？！{/i}

lines.en: : Wow. She really is closed off, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 哇。她真是拒人于千里之外啊。

lines.en: scene black
Makoto Miyamura wasn’t sure what to do. Especially since word {i}had{/i} in fact gotten around that Io had been {i}through something{/i} earlier in life.
lines.zh: Makoto Miyamura 不知道该怎么办。尤其是关于 Io 早年{i}经历过一些事{/i}的传言，其实{i}确实{/i}已经传开了。

lines.en: No one ever brought it up — but it wasn’t really out of respect for her. It was out of respect for Uta.
lines.zh: 从来没人提起过——但这其实不是出于对她的尊重，而是出于对 Uta 的尊重。

lines.en: And pity of course. {i}Mainly{/i} pity. And that nostalgic brand of unease you get from certain bouts of morbid curiosity.
lines.zh: 当然还有怜悯。{i}主要{/i}是怜悯。以及某些病态好奇心发作时，那种带着怀旧味的不安。

lines.en: Such curiosities had overtaken Makoto lately, though. And it was as if everywhere she looked, there was a part of the world she never noticed when it only moved in one direction.
lines.zh: 不过最近，这样的好奇心占据了 Makoto。她每一次环顾，都仿佛能看到世界某个过去从未留意的角落——在它只朝一个方向运转的时候。

lines.en: That was equal parts fascinating and terrifying. But was there really anything to fear at all when this life was practically permanent?
lines.zh: 这既迷人又可怕，各占一半。可当这条命几乎成了永恒，又究竟还有什么好怕的呢？

lines.en: scene makotoiobath12
Terror as a concept had become little more than a pothole on the road that is life itself. Something that makes you go “ah” for a split second, then fades away almost immediately.
lines.zh: 「恐惧」作为一个概念，已经不过是人生之路上的一个小坑。让你「啊」那么一瞬，随即几乎立刻消散。

lines.en: There’s no constant, lingering dread anymore. Just the occasional thought of, “Hey — if I die, won’t I just wake up some{i}when{/i} else?” And that blended quite smoothly with her new way of life.
lines.zh: 不再有那种持续不散的恐惧了。只是偶尔会冒出个念头：「嘿——要是我死了，不就会在别的{i}某个时候{/i}醒来吗？」而这与她新的生活方式融合得相当顺滑。

lines.en: But it {i}also{/i} compelled her to want to make the best of this one.
lines.zh: 可它{i}同时{/i}也驱使着她想把这一世活到最好。

lines.en: So despite how frequently she told herself that life now was just a series of orgasms and cups of coffee and sleeping through alarms, it was still a puzzle.
lines.zh: 所以，尽管她常对自己说如今的人生不过是一连串高潮、一杯杯咖啡和一个个睡过去的闹钟，它依然是个谜题。

lines.en: And Makoto liked puzzles.
lines.zh: 而 Makoto 喜欢谜题。

lines.en: Not just solving them either. She enjoyed those feelings of confusion and helplessness that many others cower before or fall victim to. But she had already endured her own brand of that.
lines.zh: 不只是解开它们。她还享受那份困惑与无力——许多人在它面前瑟缩、被它击倒的那种感觉。但她早已承受过属于她自己的那一份。

lines.en: So she scorned the world for killing her father but, at the same time, she felt thankful.
lines.zh: 于是她怨恨这个世界夺走了她的父亲，可与此同时，她又心怀感激。

lines.en: Because there was nothing left to {i}fear{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: 因为已经没有什么值得{i}害怕{/i}的了。

lines.en: {b}{size=+10}{s}AT LEAST FOR NOW.{/b}{/size}{/s}
lines.zh: {b}{size=+10}{s}至少现在是如此。{/b}{/size}{/s}

lines.en: : Dang, Makoto. I ain’t seen you look {i}this{/i} relaxed and satisfied since the last time you came back from Sensei’s house.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，Makoto。自从上次你从老师家回来之后，我就没见过你这么{i}放松满足{/i}。

lines.en: : Why did you have to go and ruin my moment of inner-peace like that, Miku?
lines.zh: : 你非得这么毁掉我内心的宁静时刻吗，Miku？

lines.en: scene makotoiobath13
: What’s wrong with bringin’ up the one thread tyin’ the three of us together?! This is a hot springs scene! If we ain’t gonna touch each other’s boobs, we’ve at least gotta bring up boys!
lines.zh: : 提一提把咱们三个串在一起的那条线有什么不对？！这可是温泉场景！就算不摸彼此的胸，至少也得聊聊男生吧！

lines.en: : That doesn’t give us much leeway as three heterosexuals then, does it?
lines.zh: : 那作为三个异性恋，我们能聊的余地可就不多了，不是吗？

lines.en: scene makotoiobath14
: You’re right. We better go find the one or two other girls in our class that ain’t been converted yet and drag ‘em in here or we’ll run outta topics to discuss at this rate.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我们最好去把班上还没被「转化」的一两个女孩拖进来，不然照这个速度我们很快就没话题了。

lines.en: : Io — you’ve got a list, don’t you? I ain’t even sure where to start.
lines.zh: : Io——你手上有名单吧？我都不知道从哪儿开始。

lines.en: : Of straight people? No. The only list I have is the love journal with Uta, and I’m not sure if I can publicly divulge the rankings of that without her present.
lines.zh: : 异性恋的名单？没有。我唯一有的就是和 Uta 一起写的恋爱日记，而她不在场的情况下，我不确定能不能公开那上面的排名。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath15
: Can you at least say which one of us is in the lead?
lines.zh: : 你至少能说我们谁领先吗？

lines.en: : I probably can. I just won’t because I don’t personally agree with the answer and am formally protesting the current results.
lines.zh: : 大概能。只是我不会说，因为我个人不同意那个答案，并且正式抗议目前的结果。

lines.en: : I don’t even {i}wanna{/i} know the ranking. It’s just gonna be friggin’ Ami and Ayane at the top. Rest of us are basically chop suey and gotta work harder.
lines.zh: : 我{i}根本不{/i}想知道排名。反正肯定是该死的 Ami 和 Ayane 排在最上面。我们其他人基本就是杂碎，还得加把劲。

lines.en: : Does Io even like Sensei like that, though?
lines.zh: : 不过 Io 真的那样喜欢老师吗？

lines.en: scene makotoiobath16
: You askin’ me or her? Io ain’t really told me much about that. We just talk about sports.
lines.zh: : 你是在问我还是问她？Io 没怎么跟我说过这个。我们只聊运动。

lines.en: : Io doesn’t want me to talk to her, so I’m just throwing the question out into the ether and hoping someone answers it.
lines.zh: : Io 不想让我跟她说话，所以我就把问题抛进空气里，指望有人回答。

lines.en: : I like him romantically. Just my reasons for it probably aren’t the same as yours.
lines.zh: : 我是带着恋爱的喜欢他。只是我喜欢他的理由大概和你们不同。

lines.en: : Well, there ya have it. Straight from the horse’s balls.
lines.zh: : 好了，答案来了。马蛋里掏出来的实话。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath17
: Oh! Touka! {i}She’s{/i} straight! Horse balls made me think’a her! How many we got left?
lines.zh: : 哦！Touka！{i}她{/i}是直的！马蛋让我想起她了！我们还剩几个？

lines.en: : Makoto, make a worksheet or somethin’. We’ve gotta get to the bottom of this to figure out who to invite to our straight girls hot spring club.
lines.zh: : Makoto，做个表什么的。我们得查清楚，才好决定邀请谁进我们的直女温泉俱乐部。

lines.en: : Futaba’s banned, though. I ain’t allowed near her boobs anymore.
lines.zh: : 不过 Futaba 被禁了。我已经不许再靠近她的胸了。

lines.en: : With respect to Io, we should probably stop bringing up boobs.
lines.zh: : 考虑到 Io，我们大概该别再提胸了。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath18
: Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : I understand. {i}Nobody{/i} understands more than me...
lines.zh: : 我理解。{i}没有人{/i}比我更理解了……

lines.en: : Yeah, I find that very hard to believe as you likely don’t understand at all.
lines.zh: : 是吗，我觉得很难相信，因为你大概根本不理解。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath19
: That don’t mean boys are banned though, right? Cause you still ain’t even told me what happened on your date with Sensei!
lines.zh: : 可这不代表男生也被禁了，对吧？因为你还根本没告诉我你和老师的约会发生了什么！

lines.en: : And as a girl who wants to go on dates with Sensei myself, I feel like I’ve gotta absorb as many tips as I possibly can.
lines.zh: : 作为一个自己也想和老师约会的女孩，我觉得得尽可能多吸收点技巧。

lines.en: : I {i}did{/i} tell you about what happened on the date, though. You just kept telling me I was making stuff up.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}确实{/i}告诉过你约会发生了什么。只是你一直说我瞎编。

lines.en: : Well, yeah! Cause you kept talkin' about a giant hole! And the only giant hole around here's the one between Kirin's legs.
lines.zh: : 那当然！因为你一直在说一个巨大的洞！而这附近唯一的巨洞就是 Kirin 两腿之间那个。

lines.en: : First, ew. Second, the hole is real.
lines.zh: : 第一，恶心。第二，那个洞是真的。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath20
: I still wanna hear more about what happened {i}apart{/i} from the hole, though!
lines.zh: : 可我还是想听听{i}除了{/i}那个洞之外发生了什么！

lines.en: : Was it all romantic?! You guys kiss?! Or did ya just watch baseball and eat chips or somethin’? Sounds like an Io kinda date, right?
lines.zh: : 全程浪漫吗？！你们接吻了吗？！还是就看看棒球、吃点薯片什么的？听起来很像 Io 风格的约会，对吧？

lines.en: : It would be if Sensei actually liked baseball. The two of us just went to the convenience store and then walked around for a little bit after we met up.
lines.zh: : 如果老师真喜欢棒球的话倒是。我们俩只是去了趟便利店，碰面之后又随便逛了一会儿。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath21
: ...And then encountered a giant hole that led to an endless pit of nothingness in the middle of a sewer. Kind of hard to pivot away from a development like that.
lines.zh: : ……然后就在下水道中央撞见了一个通往无尽虚无的巨洞。碰上这种展开，很难把话题岔开。

lines.en: : Damn, Io. You're so persistent about this that I'm startin' to actually believe you.
lines.zh: : 靠，Io。你这么坚持，我都要开始相信你了。

lines.en: : I'm honestly surprised you don't already. You believed me when I told you leather was made from boiling milk.
lines.zh: : 说实话我很惊讶你居然现在才信。我说皮革是煮牛奶做的那次你可是信了的。

lines.en: : Wait. You tellin' me it ain't?
lines.zh: : 等等。你是说不是吗？

lines.en: : I know you want me addressing you as little as possible, but I can’t help myself now. Question one — why were you in a sewer? And question two — “endless pit of nothingness?????”
lines.zh: : 我知道你巴不得我尽量别搭理你，可现在我忍不住了。问题一——你们为什么会在下水道里？问题二——「无尽虚无的深坑？？？？？」

lines.en: scene makotoiobath22
: It was {i}so{/i} weird! Like, I’ve been in those tunnels a million times before and had never seen that even once. It’s like it just showed up out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 那{i}真的{/i}太诡异了！就好比，那条隧道我去过一万次，从来没见过那东西一次。它就像是凭空冒出来的。

lines.en: : Okay. Say this hole {i}is{/i} real. The heck were you guys even doin’ down there?
lines.zh: : 好吧。就算这个洞{i}是{/i}真的。你们俩到底在那下面干什么？

lines.en: : Exploring, obviously! What better spot for a date than an underground adventure?! Just, the place I was specifically trying to take him to, like...wasn’t even there anymore.
lines.zh: : 当然是探险！有什么地方比地下冒险更适合约会？！只是，我特意想带他去的那个地方……就好像……根本不在那儿了。

lines.en: : And I know it sounds crazy, but it’s like the tunnels {i}changed!{/i} Which makes me think it’s either a construction thing or a result of the sinkhole that stole my school. And my pencil case.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来很疯，可那些隧道就像{i}变了样{/i}！这让我觉得要么是施工导致的，要么是那个吞掉我学校的天坑造成的。还有我的笔袋。

lines.en: : I’m still investigating right now. Uta and I are gonna try and draw a map that-
lines.zh: : 我现在还在调查。Uta 和我打算试着画张地图，好——

lines.en: : Okay, screw it! The hole is real!
lines.zh: : 好吧，管他呢！那个洞是真的！

lines.en: : You’ve gotta let me get in on this too! I promise I won’t tell anybody! Scout’s honor! Oh! And Makoto too! We can all go together!
lines.zh: : 你也得让我掺一脚！我保证不告诉任何人！童子军的荣誉！哦！还有 Makoto！我们一起去！

lines.en: : I...will have to bring this up with the tunnel council. Which is just Uta and me. But even then, her long-standing rivalry with Uta in the Dorm Wars may lead to unnecessary competition that-
lines.zh: : 我……得跟隧道委员会提一下。其实就是 Uta 和我。不过即便如此，她在宿舍战争里和 Uta 长期的宿怨可能会引发不必要的竞争，那——

lines.en: scene makotoiobath23
: Actually, you guys can do all of that without me. I don’t really have much interest in exploring a sewer right now.
lines.zh: : 其实，那些你们自己去做就行，不用带上我。我现在对探索下水道没什么兴趣。

lines.en: : Whaaaat?! But it’s a {i}cool{/i} sewer! With a big and probably real hole!
lines.zh: : 啥——？！可那是个{i}超酷{/i}的下水道！还有个很大、而且大概是真的洞！

lines.en: : It’s {i}way{/i} bigger than just a hole, Miku. It’s like...{i}unbelievable.{/i} I threw a rock down there and couldn’t even hear it hit the bottom!
lines.zh: : 它可{i}远远{/i}不只是个洞，Miku。那是……{i}难以置信{/i}。我往下面扔了块石头，连它落地的声音都听不见！

lines.en: : Seriously?! I want to throw rocks into the abyss too! You’ve gotta take me!
lines.zh: : 真的？！我也想往深渊里扔石头！你一定得带我去！

lines.en: : Hey, I’m gonna get out a little early. No need to follow after me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我先上去一会儿。不用跟着我。

lines.en: scene black
: Hm? Already? But you seemed so relaxed a few minutes ago. And this is our vacation. Don’t you wanna hang out a little while longer?
lines.zh: : 嗯？这就走了？可你几分钟前还那么放松。而且这是在度假。你不想再待会儿吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, it was great. And maybe I’ll get back in later. I just need to go make a quick phone call. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很舒服。也许我待会儿再回来泡。我只是得去打个电话。抱歉。

lines.en: : Aww, man...now our straight girls club is only two people.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，惨了……这下我们的直女俱乐部只剩两个人了。

lines.en: : I despise saying this, but that makes our club sound very not straight.
lines.zh: : 我很讨厌说这句话，可这样一来我们的俱乐部听起来一点也不直了。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath24
: ...Come on.
: Pick up...
lines.zh: : 快接……

lines.en: : {i}Uhh...hello? Mako-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}呃……喂？Mako——{/i}

lines.en: : Why didn’t you tell me about Io’s giant hole?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不告诉我 Io 那个巨洞的事？

lines.en: scene makotoiobath25
: Because unlike you, I don’t body-shame. It’s 2020, Makoto. The size of someone’s hole does not change who they really are on the inside.
lines.zh: : 因为不像你，我不会搞身材羞辱。都 2020 年了，Makoto。一个洞的大小不会改变一个人内在的样子。

lines.en: if iosex == True:
: Also, it wasn’t big at all. It's actually very nice if you can look past all of the trauma.
lines.zh: : 再说，它一点都不大。只要你能忽略那些创伤，它其实挺好的。

lines.en: scene makotoiobath26
: No, you idiot! The hole you two encountered on your date in a sewer! You didn’t think that was {i}weird{/i} and relevant to our freaky apocalyptic universe?!
lines.zh: : 不是，你这个白痴！是你们约会时在下水道里遇到的那个洞！你没觉得那很{i}诡异{/i}、而且和我们这个变态的末日宇宙有关吗？！

lines.en: : {i}Oh...That hole.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦……那个洞啊。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sorry. My mind has been kind of elsewhere all day.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}抱歉。我一整天都有点心不在焉。{/i}

lines.en: scene makotoiobath27
: When {i}isn’t{/i} it? You should have told me the moment you found something like that. It could give us some sort of hint about all of this.
lines.zh: : 你{i}什么时候不是{/i}了？你一发现那种东西就该告诉我。它可能给我们一点关于这一切的线索。

lines.en: : Massive abysses like that don’t just appear overnight and-
lines.zh: : 那种巨大的深渊不可能一夜之间冒出来，而且——

lines.en: scene makotoiobath28
: Are you having sex right now?
lines.zh: : 你们现在在做爱吗？

lines.en: scene makotoiobath29
: Uhh...
: No?
lines.zh: : 没有？

lines.en: : Ngh...aah...[norikomaster]! Who...is that?! Are they...coming to join us too?!
lines.zh: : 嗯……啊……[norikomaster]！那是……谁？！她们……也要来加入我们吗？！

lines.en: scene makotoiobath30
: It’s Makoto. Do you want to talk to her?
lines.zh: : 是 Makoto。你要跟她说话吗？

lines.en: : Haaah! Ngaaah! Okay! Pass it...here...[norikomaster]!
lines.zh: : 哈啊！嗯啊！好！把电话……给我……[norikomaster]！

lines.en: scene makotoiobath31
: {i}Noriko wants to talk to you. Here.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Noriko 想跟你说话。给你。{/i}

lines.en: : Well, {i}I{/i} don’t want to talk to her! Not while you’re-
lines.zh: : 可{i}我{/i}不想跟她说话！尤其在你正——

lines.en: : {i}Aaah! H...Nghh...Hi...Makoto! How are...ngh...you....aaaah! How are you...doing?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啊！哈……嗯……嗨……Makoto！你……嗯……还好吗……啊啊啊！你……最近怎么样？！{/i}

lines.en: scene makotoiobath32
: ..................Great! Thanks {i}so{/i} much for asking.
lines.zh: : ……………………好极了！真是{i}太{/i}感谢你关心了。

lines.en: : Can you put Sensei back on please?
lines.zh: : 能麻烦让老师接电话吗？

lines.en: : {i}I’m...ngh...trying, but...Kirin is...aaah! Oh my god! M...Makoto! You should...come play with us too!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我……嗯……在努力了，可是……Kirin 她……啊啊！哦天啊！M……Makoto！你也……该来一起玩！{/i}

lines.en: : Give...the phone...to {i}Sensei.{/i}
lines.zh: : 把……电话……给{i}老师{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}Speaking. Hey, Makoto. When will you be here?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是我。嘿，Makoto。你什么时候过来？{/i}

lines.en: scene makotoiobath31
: I won’t! I want to talk about the hole! I think we should investigate it! When you’re {i}not{/i} in the process of blowing the Dorm 10 girls’ backs out!
lines.zh: : 我不会去的！我想谈的是那个洞！我觉得我们该去调查它！在你{i}不是{/i}正忙着把 10 号宿舍那群女孩的腰干断的时候！

lines.en: : {i}I don’t...remember how to get there, though...you’ll have to ask Io.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可我……不记得怎么去那儿了……你得问 Io。{/i}

lines.en: scene makotoiobath33
: And then what? Have her repeatedly start her sentences over throughout the entire journey there while we do more end-of-the-world troubleshooting? Does that not sound annoying to you?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？让她一路不停地重起话头，而我们一边还得继续排查世界末日的毛病？你不觉得那样很烦吗？

lines.en: : Let’s just figure out how to get there on our own. It could mean something.
lines.zh: : 我们自己想办法去那儿吧。它可能意味着什么。

lines.en: : {i}Sure...or it could just be a big hole.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}行吧……也可能它就只是个大洞。{/i}

lines.en: : Things like that don’t happen without a reason, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这种事不会无缘无故发生的，老师。

lines.en: : {i}What are you talking about? Things like that happen all the time here. Haven’t you been paying attention?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你在说什么？这种事在这儿天天都有。你难道一直没注意吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene makotoiobath31
: More than you, you stupid...sex guy!
lines.zh: : 比你注意得多，你这个蠢……色鬼！

lines.en: : {i}...Sex guy?{/i}
: Goodbye!
lines.zh: : 再见！

lines.en: scene black
: Ugh! Can he not hold it in for even a single phone call? We might finally have something to go off of here!
lines.zh: : 呃！他连一通电话的功夫都憋不住吗？我们这次说不定终于有线索了！

lines.en: Clutching her phone with enough force to crack the screen, Makoto makes her way back into the dressing room and puts her clothes back on without waiting for the others.
lines.zh: Makoto 攥着手机，力道大得几乎要捏碎屏幕。她走回更衣室，没等其他人就穿回了衣服。

lines.en: scene tree3
Then she heads back to her room and spends the next few hours taking notes on other things that could be considered anomalies.
lines.zh: 随后她回到房间，花接下来几个小时记录下其他可被视为异常的现象。

lines.en: Her friends forgetting things that she remembers.
lines.zh: 她的朋友们忘掉了她记得的事。

lines.en: Strange pictures on the walls that she’d never noticed before.
lines.zh: 墙上那些她从未留意过的奇怪照片。

lines.en: A box in the corner of her room that looks like it twitches, waiting to be filled.
lines.zh: 房间角落里一个像是会抽搐的箱子，等着被填满。

lines.en: A knock on the door with no one behind it.
lines.zh: 敲门声，门后却空无一人。

lines.en: The ringing of a phone with no one on the other end.
lines.zh: 电话铃响，那头却没有人。

lines.en: Laughter from beneath the bed.
lines.zh: 从床底传来的笑声。

lines.en: As it turns out, she {i}can{/i} still feel fear.
lines.zh: 事实证明，她{i}依然{/i}会感到恐惧。

lines.en: It just stems from confusion now.
lines.zh: 只是如今它源自困惑。

lines.en: The kind she can not love, because she can not find the pieces required to solve the puzzle that produces it.
lines.zh: 是那种她无法去爱的困惑，因为她找不到解开那道谜题所需的碎片。

lines.en: scene black
By the time night falls, her notebook is a mass of black.
lines.zh: 夜幕降临之时，她的笔记本已是一片漆黑。

lines.en: She can hear the ocean when she presses her ear against it.
lines.zh: 把耳朵贴上去，她能听见海的声音。

lines.en: I used to hear the same when I would sleep with my head on your chest.
lines.zh: 从前把头枕在你胸口入睡时，我听见的也是同样的声音。
